relationships.subject: Diabetes
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 expression in trigeminal ganglia was increased in diabetic rats compared to non-diabetic counterparts.

relationships.subject: TRPV1-expressing neurons in trigeminal ganglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Local ablation of TRPV1 eliminated facial heat hyperalgesia but aggravated alveolar bone damage and osteoclastogenesis in experimental periodontitis in both diabetic and non-diabetic rats.

relationships.subject: TRPV1-expressing neurons in trigeminal ganglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemistry staining presented enhanced macrophage infiltration and M1 macrophage polarization in periodontal lesions in TRPV1-ablated groups.

key_findings: TRPV1 expression in trigeminal ganglia is increased in diabetic rats.
Ablating TRPV1-expressing trigeminal neurons aggravated alveolar bone loss and M1 macrophage infiltration in periodontitis.
